annotations.title: Read what a run actually did

description: List your Traces — the durable record of what a run DID, newest first. This is                  the other half of rig_run: a run reports that it started, and the trace is where                  the answer lands. Without it an agent can run a rig and never learn whether it                  worked, which makes the run untestable. Filter by `rig_id` (this rig's runs),                  `parent_trace_id` (the STEPS under one run — this is how you see which steps ran                  and which were skipped by a guard), `trace_kind` ('run' for the containers,                  'atomic' for individual steps), `run_id` (every trace ONE run wrote — the id rig_run                  and POST /api/rigs/run return), `node_id` or `status`. Signed in: your own traces.                  Anonymous: pass `run_id` to read a PUBLIC rig's run (anyone holding the id may; the                  runner's identity is stripped). A private run answers not-found, never forbidden.

node_id.description: One graph node's passes within a run.

parent_trace_id.description: The atomic step traces under one run — how you see which steps actually ran.

run_id.description: One run's traces — the run id rig_run / POST /api/rigs/run hand back. Works anonymously for a PUBLIC rig's run.
